thread:
June (CSM): Morning sync: MarinerLabs private VPC onboarding. Open items: NAT egress IPs for firewall, IAM trust vs role name, CMK alias & key policy, CloudTrail retention length, and Splunk cert provisioning. Short updates pls.

Arman (Network): We got their subnets (10.66.0.0/16) but not the NAT IPs. Can't pin firewall until they provide static egress. Recommend rule set: allow 443->proxy, 9000/udp for metrics collector, ssh to bastion from corp CIDR only. Sample policy I sent in ticket CS-24242.

mariner-infra: Sending NAT IPs now: 198.51.100.45, 198.51.100.46. Also transit-gw ASN is 64512 and route table ID rtb-0a1b2c3d.

Arman (Network): Got it, applying rules. Note: because they route via transit-gw we need path MTU set to 1500 and `tcp-mss` clamp to avoid fragmentation with encapsulation.

Keiko (SRE): KMS: they created alias/mla-cmk and key-id "6f7e8d9c-1234". Our automation expects alias/redwood-customer-<name>. For now we'll reference key-id in the deployment, but rotation hooks won't auto-detect. I'll add fallback steps.

Lars (Security): Key policy: current policy doesn't include our runner role ARN. We need `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-runner` with Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey perms. If they can't add it, we require a short-term exception and a ticket for remediation before renewal. Also CloudTrail retention: Mariner currently keeps 45d; our baseline for private is 365d. Renewal risk unless they accept archival or cost-share.

June (CSM): Mariner's security lead says cost is the concern. I'm proposing lifecycle: keep 90d hot, transition to Glacier Flexible Retrieval at 90d, Glacier Deep Archive at 365d. Will share delta numbers and a 3-tier sign-off option.

mariner-infra: We can accept lifecycle to Glacier after 60 days, but need confirmation that Redwood can query logs if needed for incident investigations. Also we will add key policy entry later today.

Keiko (SRE): Good. Add runbook note: if alias != alias/redwood-customer-marinerlabs, deploy with key-id and create follow-up CS ticket (CS-24243) to rename alias before rotation. CLI snippet for alias create I dropped in runbook:
```
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood-customer-marinerlabs --target-key-id 6f7e8d9c-1234
```

Lars (Security): Also ask them to enable SSE-KMS on the S3 bucket used for CloudTrail and add a policy statement permitting `s3:PutObject` from `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-runner`. Example snippet in the ticket.

June (CSM): Splunk collector: they run a private forwarder and requested our signed cert. Need fqdn and owner email. Mariner-infra, can you provide?

mariner-infra: Collector fqdn is splunk.collector.mariner.internal, owner email infra+logs@marinerlabs.com. We prefer a cert valid 180 days.

Keiko (SRE): We issue 90d by default. Can raise to 180d but will add a renewal reminder. Will create CSR and provide signed PEM.

Arman (Network): Firewall rules I'll apply in a 10m window and schedule a 15m maintenance to confirm connectivity. Also will add NAT IPs to allowlist for egress monitoring.

June (CSM): Action items recap:
- June: send cost delta + lifecycle options and escalation to Mariner security lead (due today)
- Arman: apply firewall rules and verify connectivity (today)
- Keiko: deploy with key-id fallback, add runbook step, issue cert once CSR processed (90d default, can extend to 180d with ops warning)
- Lars: review CMK policy after they push change; open renewal risk note if retention remains <365d
- mariner-infra: confirm alias rename timing and agree on lifecycle sign-off

infra-bot: Reminder: CS ticket CS-24242 has follow-ups due in 48h.

June (CSM): Thanks team. I'll post the cost numbers and request the alias rename ETA. Mid-week check-in scheduled. :thumbsup:
